author: killerwhale
name: Electric Jet Engines
description: Converts the Wheesley, Whittle, and Goliath turbofans to run on ElectricCharge instead of fuel — making atmospheric flight possible on Duna, Eve, and Jool without burning a drop of propellant. Requires a power source to operate. Each conversion (Wheesley, Whittle, Goliath, tech tree) is a campaign feature you can switch on or off per campaign. Also adds the J-404 Panther and Z-1K rechargeable battery to the Light Aviation tech node alongside the Wheesley, making early-game electric flight possible without 1000 solar panels.
